author: XtraMajestical
body: I was kicked and temp banned by Zacc for an inappropriate username yet i had approved it with many Sr Mods and was given permission by one. So first i was kicked and as i began to explain why i was then shortly after temp banned not sure why i needed two infractions but you know! My temp ban was appealed but i just would like my kick to be appealed next thanks! I want this to be appealed because my list of infractions is growing quickly and im trying to keep them low!
